# gitcli Productivity Command Guide

## AI & Automation
- `gitcli commit --ai [--style conventional|casual|emoji] [--note "..."] [--all]` — AI commit messages with optional notes and auto-stage.
- `gitcli review` — AI review of staged changes.
- `gitcli resolve --ai` — AI suggestions for merge conflicts.
- `gitcli branch create "task description" [--ai | --name <branch>]` — Smart branch naming.
- `gitcli pr summarize [--count <n> --notify]` — AI PR summary; optional Slack/Discord notify.

## Repo Insight & Hygiene
- `gitcli ui` — TUI dashboard (status, commits, branch graph, dirty files, health). Keys: `r` refresh, `a` auto-refresh, `s` status refresh, `g/G` graph top/bottom, `d/u` scroll dirty files, `q` quit.
- `gitcli impact` — Change impact hints; warns on important config/test changes.
- `gitcli clean [--prune-remote]` — Remove merged local branches; optional remote prune.
- `gitcli fun health` — Quick repo health score; `fun streak` (commit streak), `fun art` (ASCII activity).
- `gitcli history stats|list|clear` — Command usage analytics.

## Security & Guardrails
- `gitcli scan` — Secret scan on staged files (supports .gitcli-scan-allowlist).
- `gitcli hooks run` — Pre-commit tasks (Prettier, ESLint, tests).
- `gitcli hooks install` — Install git pre-commit hook to run tests.
- Protected-branch/tamper warnings and dirty-file detector run automatically.

## Collaboration & Notifications
- `gitcli pair start <ws-url> | stop` — Pair programming session via WebSocket.
- `gitcli pr summarize --notify` — Send PR summary to Slack/Discord (if configured in `~/.gitcli/config.json`).
- `gitcli plugin install <url> | list` — Manage plugins (sandboxed with allow/deny lists).

## Cloud & Sync
- `gitcli sync` — Sync history/aliases to configured cloud endpoint (uses `cloudSync` config).
- `gitcli remote <ssh-url> <git-command...>` — Run git commands over SSH.
- `gitcli stash --secure [-p password]` — AES-256 encrypted stash to `~/.gitcli/secure-stash`.

## Release & Publishing
- `gitcli release create [--tag <tag> --publish --repo owner/repo --draft]` — Generate changelog + manifest; optional GitHub release publish.

## Tips
- Plugins live in `~/.gitcli/plugins` and run in a sandbox; configure allow/deny via `pluginPolicies`.
- Set AI keys via `OPENAI_API_KEY` or `tokens.openai`; set `GITHUB_TOKEN` for releases; configure notifications in `~/.gitcli/config.json`.
- Use `gitcli ui` during work sessions for at-a-glance status, and `gitcli impact` + `gitcli scan` before commits/PRs.
